statements.verbatim_passage: The temperature regime of rivers can be drastically altered by the construction of dams (Magilligan and Nislow 2005), specifically in stratified dams, where the vertical density gradient creates a barrier preventing the combining of the water column (Omofunmi et al. 2017) and it regulates the vertical distribution of temperature and thermodynamic structure (Liu et al. 2019).
